_readme: Complementary services the bot may suggest. Enable only services your business actually offers, and write the pitch and fee yourself. The bot never invents a service, fee or partner. Triggers are fixed in src/conversation/services.js: rental_investor, growth_investor, mortgage_buyer, mortgage_question, visa_question, legal_question, off_plan_purchase, ready_purchase, end_use_buyer. feeText is optional and shown as written; leave it null when the fee depends on the case.

services.name: Leasing and property management
services.pitch: If you'd rather not manage the rental yourself, our leasing and property management service can handle tenant search, contracts and rent collection.

services.name: Mortgage advice
services.pitch: Our mortgage advice service can compare bank offers and check what you could borrow before you commit.

services.name: Handover snagging inspection
services.pitch: Before you accept the keys, our snagging inspection checks the unit for defects so the developer can fix them.

services.name: Residence visa guidance
services.pitch: Our visa guidance service can take you through the current property-visa requirements and paperwork for your case.

services.name: Furnishing package
services.pitch: Our furnishing package can get the unit ready to live in or to let without you coordinating suppliers.
